method: Live Bilibili page in anonymous isolated Chromium with installed MV3 extension. Each six-second enabled/disabled window seeks to the same source segment before measuring. No routed requests or substituted media.

environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/148.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

gpu: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) UHD Graphics (0x0000A788) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
limits: Anonymous public playback provides 640x360 media at about 30fps. Callback frequency is not distinct video frames, physical refresh rate or physical display latency. Six-second windows do not guarantee a minimum rate on other devices or pages. Logged-in messages and the user Edge installation are separate verification environments.
